title: Step 1 - Python Kernel SVM: Applying RBF to Solve Non-Linear Classification

cues.en: Instructor: Hello, my friends, and welcome to this new practical activity on, this time, the Kernel SVM model.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到新的實作活動，這次是核心 SVM 模型。

cues.en: So please follow me into Part 3 Classification to implement the Kernel SVM model.
cues.zh: 請跟我進入 Part 3 Classification，實作核心 SVM 模型。

cues.en: And, as usual, we're gonna start with Python.
cues.zh: 一樣先從 Python 開始。

cues.en: And here we are with our two files, the first one that contains the whole implementation of the Kernel SVM model in the IPYNB format,
cues.zh: 這裡有兩個檔案，第一個包含 IPYNB 格式的完整核心 SVM 模型實作，

cues.en: and the second one, the dataset, that same dataset on which we trained and will train all the classification models of this part.
cues.zh: 第二個是資料集，也就是本部分訓練所有分類模型時使用的相同資料集。

cues.en: So let's have a quick look at it again.
cues.zh: 再快速看一遍。

cues.en: This dataset contains some information of 400 customers represented by each row here.
cues.zh: 資料集包含 400 位顧客的資訊，分別由這裡每一列表示。

cues.en: So each row corresponds to a customer.
cues.zh: 所以每列對應一位顧客。

cues.en: And for each of these customers, well, we have the Age which is a first feature, the EstimatedSalary which is a second feature, and the dependent variable, Purchased,
cues.zh: 每位顧客都有第一個特徵 Age、第二個特徵 EstimatedSalary，以及應變數 Purchased，

cues.en: which tells whether or not they bought, no or yes, a previous SUV, all right?
cues.zh: 它表示是否曾購買 SUV，否或是，好嗎？

cues.en: And so in our practical activities of this Part 3 Classification, we built several classification models to understand the correlations between these two features here
cues.zh: 在 Part 3 Classification 的實作活動中，我們建立多個分類模型，理解這兩個特徵

cues.en: and this dependent variable, Purchased, in order to predict which future customers will buy brand new luxury SUV that is advertised on social networks, all right?
cues.zh: 與應變數 Purchased 的關聯，以預測哪些未來顧客會購買社群網路廣告中的全新豪華 SUV。

cues.en: So still the same story, and now, well, let's begin our Kernel SVM implementation.
cues.zh: 情境還是一樣，現在開始實作核心 SVM。

cues.en: I'm gonna open it with Google Colaboratory, but you have the choice, open it with Jupyter Notebook as well, choose your favorite, and now it is opening the notebook, loading it, laying it out, and there we go.
cues.zh: 我會用 Google Colaboratory 開啟，你也可以用 Jupyter Notebook，選自己喜歡的。現在正開啟、載入並排版筆記本，好了。

cues.en: Welcome to the Kernel SVM implementation.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到核心 SVM 實作。

cues.en: All right, and of course, it results from the exact same classification template which we made in the first section of this part, logistic regression.
cues.zh: 當然，它來自本部分第一節邏輯斯迴歸中建立的同一份分類範本。

cues.en: Indeed, when we built the logistic regression model, we made at the same time a great classification template which allows us to only change one cell
cues.zh: 建立邏輯斯迴歸模型時，我們同時製作了很棒的分類範本，讓我們建立其他分類模型時，

cues.en: when building another classification model which is exactly, you know, the cell where we build and train this classification model on the training set.
cues.zh: 只需改一個儲存格，也就是在訓練集上建立並訓練分類模型的那一格。

cues.en: So this cell is the only one we have to modify here.
cues.zh: 所以只有這個儲存格需要修改。

cues.en: However, this notebook is in read-only mode.
cues.zh: 不過這份筆記本是唯讀模式。

cues.en: So in order to modify this cell to build the Kernel SVM model, we have to indeed click File here in order to create a copy of this notebook.
cues.zh: 要修改儲存格以建立核心 SVM 模型，就必須點這裡的 File，建立筆記本副本。

cues.en: And to do this, you just need to click Save a copy in Drive.
cues.zh: 只要點 Save a copy in Drive。

cues.en: This will create a copy of this notebook, and in a second, you'll have it opened on your machine, all right?
cues.zh: 就會建立筆記本副本，稍後在你的電腦上開啟，好嗎？

cues.en: So I'm gonna put everything in that order, all right?
cues.zh: 我先把它們依這個順序排好。

cues.en: And this is our copy, and so inside, the only thing we have to re-implement is, indeed, that cell where we build and train the Kernel SVM model on the training set.
cues.zh: 這就是副本，其中唯一需要重新實作的，就是在訓練集上建立並訓練核心 SVM 模型的儲存格。

cues.en: So let's not look at it, let's put it in the trash, and now let's re-implement it from scratch.
cues.zh: 先不看內容，把它丟到垃圾桶，現在從頭實作。

cues.en: All right, perfect. So it's actually super, super easy.
cues.zh: 好，非常簡單。

cues.en: We can even do it even more efficiently than, you know, the usual way when we went to the scikit-learn API, then got the name of the function
cues.zh: 甚至能比平常到 scikit-learn API、查函式名稱的方式，

cues.en: because, as I explained in the previous section when building the SVM model, the classic one, well, the way we built it was actually to, you know, build an object of this class, as we see,
cues.zh: 更有效率。因為上一節建立傳統 SVM 模型時，我解釋過，建立方式其實就是建立 SVC 類別的物件，

cues.en: and then choose a linear kernel.
cues.zh: 再選擇線性核心。

cues.en: And now, actually, you know, we're about to do the same.
cues.zh: 現在其實也要做同樣的事。

cues.en: We're about to use the same class to build these Kernel SVM objects.
cues.zh: 使用相同類別建立這些核心 SVM 物件。

cues.en: But this time, instead of choosing a linear kernel, we will choose a non-linear one, and that's the best example of it, you know, the most commonly used.
cues.zh: 但這次不選線性核心，而選非線性核心。最好的例子，也是最常用的，

cues.en: It is the RBF, radial basis function, kernel.
cues.zh: 就是 RBF，徑向基底函數核心。

cues.en: And you also have some other ones like the polynomial kernel or the sigmoid kernel.
cues.zh: 也有其他類型，例如多項式核心或 sigmoid 核心。

cues.en: But, really, this one is the best option to start with, and that's the one we'll choose for our Kernel SVM implementation, as you might have guessed.
cues.zh: 不過這個確實是入門的最佳選擇，你應該也猜到了，我們的核心 SVM 實作就選它。

cues.en: And therefore, remember how I also wanna train you on how to juggle with the different tools of your machine learning toolkit, you know, the data preprocessing toolkit, or the regression toolkit,
cues.zh: 記得我也想訓練你靈活運用機器學習工具箱中的各種工具，像資料前處理工具箱、迴歸工具箱，

cues.en: or, even now, the classification toolkit containing all your classification models.
cues.zh: 或現在包含所有分類模型的分類工具箱。

cues.en: The most efficient way now to build this Kernel SVM model is just to go back to our SVM implementation, then find that cell where we built the SVM.
cues.zh: 現在建立核心 SVM 模型最有效率的方式，就是回到 SVM 實作，找到建立 SVM 的儲存格。

cues.en: And, indeed, since we built the SVM with the same class SVC but choosing a linear kernel, well, now, as simple as that, in order to build our Kernel SVM,
cues.zh: 因為當時使用相同的 SVC 類別，只是選了線性核心，所以現在要建立核心 SVM，

cues.en: we just need to take this code cell and paste it right here in a new code cell, and then guess what?
cues.zh: 只需要把這個程式碼儲存格複製，貼到這裡新的儲存格中，然後猜猜怎麼做？

cues.en: Just change that kernel parameter, all right?
cues.zh: 只需修改 kernel 參數，好嗎？

cues.en: And as we said, this time, we're not using a linear kernel.
cues.zh: 剛才說過，這次不用線性核心。

cues.en: We're gonna use an rbf kernel, the radial basis function, which was explained in the Intuition lectures.
cues.zh: 要用 rbf 核心，也就是直覺教學中解釋過的徑向基底函數。

cues.en: And there you go, my friend, that implementation is over.
cues.zh: 朋友，實作到這裡就完成了。

cues.en: You see how I'm doing all these templates to make you as most efficient as possible.
cues.zh: 你看到我用這些範本，讓你盡可能有效率。

cues.en: Well, that's what I mean.
cues.zh: 這就是我的意思。

cues.en: Now, we can juggle between our different codes, different tools of machine learning, and we can build new models in Flashlight.
cues.zh: 現在能靈活切換不同程式碼、不同機器學習工具，迅速建立新模型。

cues.en: And that's what we just did with Kernel SVM.
cues.zh: 我們剛才就是這樣建立核心 SVM。

cues.en: All right, so basically we're done, we're ready.
cues.zh: 好，基本上完成了，準備好了。

cues.en: Still the same story.
cues.zh: 流程還是一樣。

cues.zh: 幾秒後應該就能看到 Upload 按鈕。

cues.zh: 很好，出現了。

cues.zh: 接著 Python，然後 Social_Network_Ads.csv。

cues.zh: 現在點這裡的 Runtime，再選 Run all，就可以執行全部內容。
